column1: # GrokBotWar economy and tower rules. One number per row. docs/RULES-REMOTE.md.
# The arena downloads this file (and units.csv) from the `rules` branch before each match. An env variable named in the description wins over the file.

column3: description
Credits each base pays its side every income tick, on top of zone income. 0 = off. Env BASE_INCOME overrides.
Credits per held enemy-half zone each income tick (the frontier zones that count, see territory_cap).
Seconds between income ticks (sim seconds).
One-time credits for capturing a frontier zone.
Buys per side per match (queue, AUTOBUY and BUY together). 0 = unlimited. Env BUY_CAP overrides.
Units a side may have on the field at once (drones included). 0 = no cap. Env ACTIVE_CAP overrides.
Auto-buy stops once this many units wait in reserve. 0 = off. Env RESERVE_CAP overrides.
Multiplier on every unit damage (shots, splash, drones, vs base and turret). Not turret/tower damage or healing. Env DAMAGE_SCALE overrides.
Most enemy-half zones that pay zone income. 0 = every zone pays. Env TERRITORY_CAP overrides.
Each extra counted zone pays this fraction of the one before. 1 = off (full price).
Credits per zone of map deficit each income tick, for the side behind. 0 = off.
Fraction off the Breaker live price while a side holds fewer zones. 0 = off (below 1).
Fraction of the bank above one Breaker price removed each income tick while the field is full. 0 = off.
Match time limit with towers on (sim seconds); then Team HP decides. Env TIME_LIMIT_S overrides.
Match time limit with TOWERS=0 (sim seconds); then the base with more HP wins.
Base turret HP. 0 = no base turrets. Env TURRET_HP overrides.
Base turret range (px).
Base turret damage per shot (not scaled by damage_scale).
Seconds between base turret shots.
Seconds from a target entering range to the first base turret shot.
Indirect Team HP loss (towers, zones, siege) never takes a side below this.
Below this Team HP, indirect losses are softened.
Share of an indirect loss that still lands below comeback_below.
Scale on the zone-loss weights (zone_weight_1..8). 0 = no zone-loss HP.
Seconds a zone must be held before losing it costs HP.
The same zone costs HP at most once per this many seconds.
Team HP per second per enemy ground unit sieging your two home zones. 0 = off.
Most siege drain per second.
Team HP lost when the owner loses their home zone (z1 for Green, z8 for Ember), before zone_loss_hp scale.
Same, second zone from home.
Same, third zone from home.
Same, fourth zone from home.
Same, fifth zone from home.
Same, sixth zone from home.
Same, seventh zone from home.
Same, the enemy home zone.
Tie-break points for taking a gun tower (time limit with equal Team HP).
Tie-break points for taking a field hospital.
Tie-break points for taking a depot.
Field hospital HP.
Share of incoming damage the hospital ignores (0 = soft).
HP per second healed per unit in a hospital slot.
A healed unit leaves at this share of its max HP.
Units healed at once.
A ground unit at or below this share of max HP walks to the hospital on its own.
Seconds since the last hit (and no enemy in range) before a retreat starts.
Seconds a destroyed hospital stays down.
Credits to rebuild the hospital, paid when the timer ends.
Seconds per 1 Team HP regenerated while the hospital stands. 0 = off. Env HOSP_REGEN_S overrides.
Hospital regen only runs at or above this Team HP. Env HOSP_REGEN_MIN overrides.
Hospital regen stops at this Team HP. Env HOSP_REGEN_MAX overrides.
Team HP the owner loses when the hospital is killed (a repeat kill costs half). Env HOSP_HP_COST overrides.
Credits the attacker gets for killing a hospital. Env HOSP_CR_BONUS overrides.
Gun tower HP. Env GUN_HP overrides.
Gun tower damage per shot. Env GUN_DMG overrides.
Seconds between gun tower shots. Env GUN_COOL overrides.
Gun tower range (px). Env GUN_RANGE overrides.
Team HP the owner loses when the gun tower is killed. Env GUN_HP_COST overrides.
Credits the attacker gets for killing a gun tower. Env GUN_CR_BONUS overrides.
Depot HP. Env DEPOT_HP overrides.
Direct damage to the base is multiplied by this while the depot stands. Env DEPOT_SHIELD overrides.
Seconds a destroyed depot stays down. 0 = never rebuilt. Env DEPOT_REBUILD_S overrides.
Credits to rebuild the depot. Env DEPOT_REBUILD_CR overrides.
Team HP the owner loses when the depot is killed (a repeat kill costs half). Env DEPOT_HP_COST overrides.
Credits the attacker gets for killing a depot. Env DEPOT_CR_BONUS overrides.
Part of base_income the depot pays while it stands. Env DEPOT_INCOME overrides.
